flags.title: The supplied short-link tokens do not match the ASIN format, and each resolves to a different ASIN
flags.detail: Each link.amazon token is 9 characters (for example B04G1MEwY). Amazon describes an ASIN as a 10-character code. Each token redirects to a different product page ASIN (see the products table). The token therefore cannot be treated as an ASIN. The intended ASIN is recorded as unverified, and the redirect target is kept in a separate field.

sources.label: link.amazon/B04G1MEwY (redirects to B0CDY277D3)
Amazon Seller Central forum: ASIN is a 10-character identifier (Amazon-hosted, secondary; formal help page not retrieved)
